To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

intraindividual reproducible nasal responses to diesel exhaust particle (DEP) adjuvant effects were observed in a group of rhinitic volunteers, and that these reproducible responses were independent of the response to the allergen challenge.
intraindividual reproducible nasal allergic responses to DEP indicate a susceptible phenotype.
the reproducible effects of DEP in enhancing nasal allergic responses are intrinsic and independent of response to allergen.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of diesel exhaust particles ( DEPs ) on the human immune system.
the effects of DEP on the allergic response to allergen and how this response can be used to identify susceptible individuals to DEP exposure.
the reproducibility and reliability of nasal challenges with allergen and diesel exhaust particles (a mixture of organic and inorganic components) in humans.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reproducibility is good for IgE, and moderate for cytokines.
the reproducibility is high, but it is not high enough to be used as a diagnostic test.
the reproducible effects of DEPs are not due to the effects of DEPs alone, but rather to the combined effects of DEPs and allergens.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated the reproducibility and utility of a combined nasal challenge protocol for the assessment of susceptibility to DEP adjuvant effects.
the adjuvant effects of diesel exhaust particles on allergic responses can be quantified and are reproducible.
DEPs ability to augment allergic responses is a reproducible phenomenon, and that this reproducibility can be used to identify a susceptible phenotype.
The main takeaway from our work is that
intraindividual reproducible allergic responses can be used to assess susceptibility to the adjuvant effects of diesel exhaust particles.
DEP's ability to enhance allergic reactions is highly reproducible within an individual.
intraindividual reproducible responses to combined allergen + diesel particle challenges indicate that susceptibility to DEP adjuvants effects is intrinsic.
